entries.38.1: महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, राघवः Raghava, एवम् thus, अहन्यहनि day after day, पौरजानपदेषु च in the affairs of townsfolk and country folk, सर्वकार्याणि all business, प्रशासत् governing, आस्ते abode
entries.38.2: ततः then, कतिपयाहःसु after some few days, राघवः Raghava, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, मिथिलाधिपम् the lord of Mithila, वैदेहम् the Videha king, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.38.3: भवान् हि your honour indeed, अव्यग्रा unfailing, गतिः is our support, भवता by you, वयम् we, पालिताः have been protected, भवतः your, उग्रेण fierce, तेजसा by the splendour, रावणः Ravana, मया by me, निहतः was slain
entries.38.4: राजन् O king, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, सर्वेषाम् all, मैथिलानां च and of the Maithilas, सर्वशः in every way, सम्बन्धकपुरोगमाः founded upon this alliance, अतुलाः unmatched, प्रीतयः are the bonds of affection
entries.38.5: पार्थिव O king, तत् therefore, भवान् your honour, रत्नानि the jewels, आदाय having taken, स्वपुरम् to his own city, यातु let him go, भरतश्च and Bharata, सहायार्थम् for your aid, ते you, पृष्ठतः behind, अनुयास्यति shall follow
entries.38.6: सः he, नृपः the king, तथा इति so be it, कृत्वा having said, राघवम् to Raghava, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, राजन् O king, भवतः your, दर्शनेन by the sight, नयेन च and by your statecraft, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased
entries.38.7: राजन् O king, यानि एतानि these which, रत्नानि jewels, मदर्थम् for my own use, सञ्चितानि वै have been gathered, तानि those, सर्वाणि एव all of them, दुहित्रे to my daughter, ददामि च I give away
entries.38.8: एवम् thus, काकुत्स्थम् to Kakutstha, उक्त्वा having spoken, हृष्टमानसः glad at heart, श्रीमान् the illustrious, जनकः Janaka, तम् that, राघवम् Raghava, अनुज्ञाय having taken leave of, मिथिलाम् to Mithila, प्रययौ set out
entries.38.9: ततः then, जनके when Janaka, प्रयाते had departed, प्रभुः the lord, राघवः Raghava, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, मातुलम् his maternal uncle, केकयम् the Kekaya king, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.38.10: राजन् O king, पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, इदम् this, राज्यम् kingdom, अहं चैव and I myself, सलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, भरतश्च and Bharata, आयत्ताः depend upon you, त्वं हि you indeed, नः our, गतिश्च are our refuge
entries.38.11: राजा the king, हि indeed, वृद्धः is aged, त्वदर्थम् on your account, सन्तापम् distress, उपयास्यति he will suffer, तस्मात् therefore, पार्थिव O king, अद्य एव this very day, गमनम् departure, तव for you, रोचते seems best
entries.38.12: अनुयात्रेण as escort, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, पृष्ठतः behind, अनुगमिष्यते you shall be followed, विपुलम् abundant, धनम् wealth, विविधानि च and various, रत्नानि jewels, आदाय taking with you
entries.38.13: युधाजित् तु and Yudhajit, गमनम् प्रति as to the departure, राघवम् to Raghava, तथा इति so be it, आह said, रत्नानि the jewels, धनं चैव and the wealth, त्वयि एव in you alone, अक्षय्यम् inexhaustible, अस्तु इति let them be
entries.38.14: सः he, केकयवर्धनः the increaser of the Kekayas, राजानम् the king, प्रदक्षिणम् the rightward circling, कृत्वा having made, पूर्वम् first, रामेण by Rama, अभिवाद्य having been saluted, प्रदक्षिणम् the circling, कृतः हि was indeed made
entries.38.15: केकयेश्वरः the lord of the Kekayas, सहायेन as his companion, लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, प्रयातः set forth, असुरे the asura, वृत्रे Vritra, हते यथा as when he was slain, विष्णुना सह along with Vishnu, वासवः Vasava
entries.38.16: ततः then, रामः Rama, तम् that, अकुतोभयम् who feared nothing from any quarter, वयस्यम् friend, काशिपतिम् the lord of Kashi, प्रतर्दनम् Pratardana, विसृज्य taking leave of, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said
entries.38.17: राजन् O king, भवता by you, प्रीतिः affection, दर्शिता has been shown, परम् supreme, सौहृदम् friendship, दर्शितम् has been shown, त्वया सह along with you, भरतेन by Bharata, उद्योगश्च and the effort, कृतः was made
entries.38.18: काशेय O lord of Kashi, तत् therefore, भवान् your honour, अद्य today, त्वया by you, गुप्ताम् guarded, रमणीयाम् delightful, सुप्रकाशाम् shining bright, सुतोरणाम् with fair archways, वाराणसीम् Varanasi, पुरीम् the city, व्रज go to
entries.38.19: एतावत् this much, उक्त्वा having said, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, परमासनात् from his high seat, उत्थाय having risen, उरोगतम् him who came to his breast, निरन्तरम् closely, पर्यष्वजत embraced
entries.38.20: तदा then, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः the increaser of the joy of Kausalya, विसर्जयामास gave him leave, राघवेण by Raghava, अभ्यनुज्ञातः permitted, अकुतोभयः the fearless one, काशीशः अपि the lord of Kashi too, राघवेण by Raghava, विसर्जितः dismissed, तूर्णम् swiftly, वाराणसीम् to Varanasi, ययौ went
entries.38.21: तम् that, काशिपतिम् lord of Kashi, विसृज्य having dismissed, राघवः Raghava, प्रहसन् smiling, त्रिशतम् the three hundred, पृथिवीपतीन् lords of the earth, मधुराक्षरम् sweet of syllable, वाक्यम् word, उवाच spoke
entries.38.22: भवताम् your, प्रीतिः affection, अव्यग्रा unwavering, तेजसा by your splendour, परिरक्षिता has been preserved, धर्मश्च and dharma, नित्यम् always, नियतः is steadfast, भवताम् your, सत्यं च and truth, सदा ever
entries.38.23: महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, युष्माकम् your, अनुभावेन by the influence, तेजसा च and by the splendour, दुरात्मा the wicked, दुर्बुद्धिः evil-minded, राक्षसाधमः basest of rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, हतः was slain
entries.38.24: तत्र therein, अहम् I, हेतुमात्रम् was but the instrument, भवताम् your, तेजसा by the splendour, युद्धे in battle, सगणः with his hosts, सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवः with his sons and ministers and kinsmen, रावणः Ravana, हतः was slain
entries.38.25: जनकराजस्य of king Janaka, तनयाम् the daughter, काननात् from the forest, हृताम् carried off, श्रुत्वा having heard, भवन्तश्च your honours, महात्मना by the great-souled, भरतेन by Bharata, समानीताः were gathered
entries.38.26: उद्युक्तानाम् who stood ready, महात्मनाम् great-souled, सर्वेषाम् of all, पार्थिवानाम् the kings, सुमहान् a very long, कालः time, व्यतीतः has passed, अतः therefore, गमनम् your departure, रोचयामि I think fitting
entries.38.27: महता with great, हर्षेण joy, वृताः filled, राजानः the kings, तम् to him, प्रत्यूचुः replied, राम O Rama, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, त्वम् you, विजयी are victorious, स्वराज्ये अपि in your own kingdom too, प्रतिष्ठितः are established
entries.38.28: दिष्ट्या by good fortune, सीता Sita, प्रत्याहृता has been recovered, दिष्ट्या by good fortune, शत्रुः the enemy, पराजितः has been defeated, एषः this, नः our, परमः supreme, कामः desire, एषा this, नः our, उत्तमा highest, प्रीतिः joy
entries.38.29: राम O Rama, यत् that, हतशात्रवम् with your foes destroyed, विजयिनम् victorious, त्वाम् you, पश्यामः we behold
entries.38.30: यत् that, त्वम् you, अस्मान् us, प्रशंससे praise, एतत् this, त्वयि in you, उपपन्नं च is indeed fitting, प्रशंसार्ह O you who deserve praise, ईदृशीम् such, प्रशंसाम् praise, वक्तुम् to utter, न जानीमः we know not how
entries.38.31: आपृच्छामः we take our leave, गमिष्यामः we shall go, भवान् your honour, सदा always, नः in our, हृदिस्थः dwells in the heart, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, महता with great, प्रीत्या affection, वृताः filled, अत्र herein, वर्तामहे we abide, महाराज O great king, ते your, प्रीतिः affection, अस्मासु toward us, नित्यदा for ever, भवेच्च may there be
entries.38.32: बाढम् इति so be it, एव indeed, हर्षेण with joy, परमान्विताः filled to the utmost, गमनोत्सुकाः eager to depart, सर्वे all, राजानः the kings, प्राञ्जलयः with joined palms, राघवम् to Raghava, ऊचुः said
entries.38.33: रामेण by Rama, पूजिताश्चैव and duly honoured, स्वकान् स्वकान् each his own, देशान् lands, जग्मुः went to
entries.39.1: ते those, महात्मानः great-souled, पार्थिवाः kings, प्रहृष्टवत् right joyfully, गजवाजिसहस्रौघैः with their floods of thousands of elephants and horses, वसुन्धराम् the earth, कम्पयन्तः making tremble, प्रयाताः set forth
entries.39.2: तत्र there, राघवार्थे for the sake of Raghava, समुद्यताः mustered, भरतस्य of Bharata, आज्ञया at the command, अनेकाः many, अक्षौहिण्यः armies, प्रहृष्टाः exultant, बलवाहनाः with troops and mounts, हि indeed, आसन् there were
entries.39.3: बलदर्पसमन्विताः puffed with pride of strength, ते those, महीपालाः rulers of the earth, ऊचुः said, युद्धे in the battle, पुरतः before us, स्थितम् standing, रामरावणम् the contest of Rama and Ravana, न पश्यामः we did not see
entries.39.4: वयम् we, भरतेन by Bharata, पश्चात् afterwards, निरर्थकम् to no purpose, समानीताः were assembled, पार्थिवैः by the kings, राक्षसाः the rakshasas, क्षिप्रम् swiftly, हताः स्युः would have been slain, हि indeed, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.39.5: रामस्य of Rama, लक्ष्मणस्य च and of Lakshmana, बाहुवीर्येण by the might of the arms, रक्षिताः protected, विगतज्वराः free of care, पारेसमुद्रस्य beyond the ocean, सुखम् with ease, युध्येम we might have fought
entries.39.6: एताः these, चान्याः and other, कथाः tales, तत्र there, सहस्रशः by the thousand, कथयन्तः recounting, राजानः the kings, हर्षसमन्विताः filled with joy, स्वराज्यानि to their own kingdoms, जग्मुः went
entries.39.7: स्वानि their own, मुख्यानि foremost, ऋद्धानि prosperous, मुदितानि च and glad, समृद्धधनधान्यानि rich in wealth and grain, पूर्णानि full, वसुमन्ति च and abounding in substance, राज्यानि realms
entries.39.8: ते they, नृपाः the kings, यथापुराणि each to his own city, गत्वा having gone, अथ then, रामस्य of Rama, प्रियकामार्थम् out of desire to please, विविधानि various, रत्नानि jewels, उपहारान् as gifts, ददुः sent
entries.39.9: अश्वान् horses, यानानि carriages, रत्नानि jewels, मदोत्कटान् rutting, हस्तिनश्च and elephants, मुख्यानि choice, चन्दनानि च and sandalwood, दिव्यानि heavenly, आभरणानि च and ornaments
entries.39.10: मणिमुक्ताप्रवालान् gems and pearls and coral, रूपसमन्विताः endowed with beauty, दास्यः handmaids, विविधान् of many kinds, अजाविकांश्च and goats and sheep, विविधान् various, रथान् तु and chariots, ददुः they gave
entries.39.11: महाबलाः the mighty, भरतः Bharata, लक्ष्मणश्चैव and Lakshmana, शत्रुघ्नश्च and Shatrughna, तानि those, रत्नानि jewels, आदाय having taken, स्वाम् their own, पुरीम् city, पुनः again, आगताः returned to
entries.39.12: पुरुषर्षभाः those bulls among men, रम्याम् the lovely, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, पुरीम् city, आगम्य च having reached, चित्राणि wondrous, तानि those, रत्नानि jewels, रामाय to Rama, समुपाहरन् presented
entries.39.13: महात्मा the great-souled, रामः Rama, प्रीतिसमन्वितः filled with pleasure, तत् that, सर्वम् all, प्रतिगृह्य च having received, कृतकर्मणे who had done his part, राज्ञे to king, सुग्रीवाय Sugriva, ददौ gave it
entries.39.14: राघवः Raghava, बिभीषणाय to Vibhishana, ददौ gave, तथा likewise, अन्येभ्यः अपि to others also, राक्षसेभ्यः to the rakshasas, कपिभ्यश्च and to the monkeys, यैः by whom, वृतः surrounded, जयम् victory, आप्तवान् he had won
entries.39.15: ते those, सर्वे all, महाबलाः mighty, कपिराक्षसाः monkeys and rakshasas, रामदत्तानि given by Rama, रत्नानि the jewels, शिरोभिः upon their heads, बाहुभिश्च and upon their arms, धारयामासुः wore
entries.39.16: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, नृपतिः the king, महारथः the great chariot-warrior, वीर्यवान् the valorous, हनूमन्तं च Hanuman, महाबाहुम् the mighty-armed, अङ्गदं च and Angada, अङ्कम् upon his lap, आरोप्य having drawn
entries.39.17: कमलपत्राक्षः lotus-petal-eyed, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said, अयम् this, अङ्गदः Angada, ते your, सुपुत्रः goodly son, अनिलात्मजः the son of the wind, मन्त्री चापि and your counsellor too
entries.39.18: हरीश्वर O lord of the vanaras, सुग्रीवमन्त्रिते in the counsels of Sugriva, युक्तौ engaged, मम my, हिते in the good, चापि also, रतौ devoted, त्वत्कृते वै for your sake indeed, विविधाम् manifold, पूजाम् honour, अर्हतः they deserve
entries.39.19: इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, महायशाः he of great renown, अङ्गात् from his own body, भूषणानि the ornaments, व्यवमुच्य having taken off, सः he, तदा then, महार्हाणि of great worth, अङ्गदहनूमतोः upon Angada and Hanuman, बबन्ध bound them
entries.39.20: राघवः Raghava, महावीर्यान् of great valour, यूथपर्षभान् the bulls among troop-leaders, आभाष्य च having addressed, नीलम् Nila, नलम् Nala, केसरिणम् Kesari, कुमुदम् Kumuda, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana
entries.39.21: सुषेणम् Sushena, पनसम् Panasa, वीरम् the hero, मैन्दम् Mainda, द्विविदम् एव च and Dvivida, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, गवाक्षं च and Gavaksha, विनतम् Vinata, धूम्रम् एव च and Dhumra
entries.39.22: वलीमुखम् Valimukha, प्रजङ्घं च and Prajangha, महाबलम् the mighty, सन्नादं च and Sannada, दरीमुखम् Darimukha, दधिमुखम् Dadhimukha, यूथपम् the troop-leader, इन्द्रजानुं च and Indrajanu
entries.39.23: श्लक्ष्णया in a gentle, वाचा voice, मधुरम् sweetly, नेत्राभ्याम् with his eyes, आपिबन् इव as if drinking them in, भवन्तश्च your honours, मे my, सुहृदः are friends, तथा likewise, शरीरम् my own body, भ्रातरः and my brothers
entries.39.24: काननौकसः O dwellers of the forest, अहम् I, युष्माभिः by you, व्यसनात् from calamity, उद्धृतः च have been lifted up, राजा king, सुग्रीवश्च and Sugriva, सुहृदाम् among friends, वरैः the best, भवद्भिः through your honours, धन्यः is blessed
entries.39.25: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, नरर्षभः the bull among men, तेभ्यः to them, यथार्हतः as each deserved, भूषणानि ornaments, महार्हाणि of great worth, वज्राणि च and diamonds, ददौ gave, सस्वजे च and embraced them
entries.39.26: मधुपिङ्गलाः tawny as honey, ते they, सुगन्धीनि fragrant, मधूनि wines, सुमृष्टानि well dressed, मांसानि च and meats, मूलानि च and roots, फलानि च and fruits, पिबन्तः partaking of
entries.39.27: एवम् thus, निवसताम् as they dwelt there, तेषाम् for them, तदा then, साग्रः a full, मासः month, ययौ passed, ते they, सर्वे all, रामभक्त्या च out of devotion to Rama, मुहूर्तम् इव as but a moment, मेनिरे accounted it
entries.39.28: रामः अपि Rama too, कामरूपिभिः taking any form at will, तैः those, वानरैः with the vanaras, महावीर्यैः of great valour, राक्षसैश्च and rakshasas, महाबलैः of great strength, ऋक्षैश्चैव and bears, सार्धम् together, रेमे took delight
entries.39.29: एवम् thus, प्रहृष्टानाम् rejoicing, वानराणाम् of the vanaras, राक्षसानां च and of the rakshasas, सर्वशः in every way, द्वितीयः a second, शिशिरः of the cold season, मासः month, सुखम् happily, ययौ passed
entries.39.30: रम्ये in the lovely, इक्ष्वाकुनगरे city of the Ikshvakus, पराम् supreme, प्रीतिम् delight, उपासताम् of those who enjoyed, रामस्य of Rama, प्रीतिकरणैः by his acts of kindness, तेषाम् their, कालः time, सुखम् happily, ययौ passed
entries.40.1: तथा so, तेषाम् those, ऋक्षवानररक्षसाम् bears and vanaras and rakshasas, वसताम् as they dwelt, महातेजाः of great splendour, राघवः तु Raghava then, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said
entries.40.2: सौम्य O gentle one, सुरासुरैः even by gods and asuras, दुराधर्षाम् unassailable, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkindha, गम्यताम् let there be a going, सहामात्यः along with your ministers, निहतकण्टकम् its thorns destroyed, राज्यम् the kingdom, पालयस्व rule
entries.40.3: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, परमया with the utmost, प्रीत्या affection, युतः filled, त्वम् you, अङ्गदं च Angada, हनुमन्तं च and Hanuman, सुमहाबलम् the exceedingly strong, नलं च and Nala, पश्य look upon
entries.40.4: वीरम् the heroic, श्वशुरम् your father-in-law, सुषेणम् Sushena, बलिनाम् among the strong, वरम् the best, तारं च and Tara, दुर्धर्षम् unassailable, कुमुदं चैव and Kumuda, महाबलम् of great strength, नीलं चैव and Nila
entries.40.5: वीरम् the hero, शतवलिं चैव and Shatabali, मैन्दम् Mainda, द्विविदम् एव च and Dvivida, गजम् Gaja, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, गवयम् Gavaya, महाबलम् the mighty, शरभं च and Sharabha, गन्धमादनम् एव च and Gandhamadana, प्रीतिसमायुक्तः filled with affection, पश्य look upon
entries.40.6: सुविक्रान्तम् of great prowess, ऋषभं च and Rishabha, महाबलम् the mighty, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, ये च and those who, इमे these, सुमहात्मानः exceedingly great-souled, मदर्थे for my sake, त्यक्तजीविताः gave up their lives
entries.40.7: त्वम् you, प्रीतिसंयुक्तः filled with affection, पश्य look upon them, एषाम् to them, विप्रियम् anything unpleasing, मा च कृथाः do not do
entries.40.8: एवम् thus, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, उक्त्वा तु having spoken, पुनः पुनः again and again, आश्लिष्य च and having embraced him, अथ then, रामः Rama, मधुरया in a sweet, गिरा voice, विभीषणम् to Vibhishana, उवाच said
entries.40.9: धर्मेण by righteousness, लङ्काम् Lanka, प्रशाधि rule, त्वम् you, धर्मज्ञः a knower of dharma, मम by me, मतः are held to be, पुरस्य of the city, राक्षसानां च and of the rakshasas, स्वभ्रातुः by your own brother, सम्मतः हि esteemed indeed, असि you are
entries.40.10: राजन् O king, त्वम् you, कथञ्चन in any wise, अधर्मे toward unrighteousness, बुद्धिम् your mind, मा च कुर्याः turn not, बुद्धिमन्तः the wise, राजानः kings, हि indeed, ध्रुवम् assuredly, मेदिनीम् the earth, अश्नन्ति enjoy
entries.40.11: राजन् O king, अहं च and I, सुग्रीवसहितः together with Sugriva, नित्यशः always, त्वया by you, परया with the utmost, प्रीत्या affection, स्मर्तव्यः are to be remembered, त्वम् you, विगतज्वरः free of care, गच्छ go
entries.40.12: रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः the bears and vanaras and rakshasas, साधु साधु इति well done and well done, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha, पुनः पुनः again and again, प्रशशंसुः praised
entries.40.13: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, राम O Rama, तव your, बुद्धिः wisdom, वीर्यम् valour, अद्भुतम् एव च and indeed wondrous, परमम् supreme, माधुर्यम् sweetness, स्वयम्भोः इव as of the self-born, नित्यदा for ever
entries.40.14: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणानाम् as they spoke, तेषाम् among those, वानराणां च vanaras, राक्षसाम् and rakshasas, हनूमान् Hanuman, प्रवणः bowing low, भूत्वा having become, राघवम् to Raghava, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.40.15: राजन् O king, मे my, परमः utmost, स्नेहः affection, त्वयि in you, नित्यदा for ever, तिष्ठतु let it abide, वीर O hero, भक्तिश्च and devotion, नियता is fixed, भावः my heart, अन्यत्र elsewhere, न गच्छतु let it not go
entries.40.16: वीर O hero, यावत् so long as, रामकथा the story of Rama, महीतले upon the face of the earth, चरिष्यति shall move, तावत् so long, मम my, प्राणाः life-breaths, शरीरे in the body, वत्स्यन्ति shall dwell, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.40.17: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, नरर्षभ O bull among men, यत् which, एतत् this, दिव्यम् heavenly, चरितम् deed, ते your, कथा story, तत् that, अप्सरसो नाम the apsaras by name, मया to me, श्रावयेयुः may they cause to be heard
entries.40.18: वीर O hero, प्रभो O lord, तत् that, तव your, चर्यामृतम् nectar of deeds, श्रुत्वा having heard, ततः then, अहम् I, अनिलः the wind, मेघलेखाम् इव as it does a line of cloud, ताम् that, उत्कण्ठाम् longing, हरिष्यामि shall dispel
entries.40.19: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणम् as he spoke, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, रामः तु Rama then, वरासनात् from his excellent seat, उत्थाय having risen, स्नेहात् out of affection, सस्वजे embraced him, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.40.20: कपिश्रेष्ठ O best of monkeys, एतत् this, एवम् so, भविता shall be, अत्र herein, न संशयः there is no doubt, लोके in the world, यावत् so long as, एषा this, मामिका of mine, कथा tale, चरिष्यति shall move, तावत् so long, ते your, कीर्तिः fame, भविता shall be, शरीरे in the body, असवः तथा and likewise the life-breaths
entries.40.21: लोकाः the worlds, हि indeed, यावत् so long as, स्थास्यन्ति shall endure, तावत् so long, मे my, कथा story, स्थास्यति shall endure
entries.40.22: कपे O monkey, एकैकस्य of each single, उपकारस्य act of service, ते to you, प्राणान् my life-breaths, दास्यामि I would give, नरः a man, प्रत्युपकाराणाम् for the returning of services, आपत् तु but calamity, पात्रताम् fitness for them, आयाति comes to
entries.40.23: ततः then, सः that, राघवः Raghava, कण्ठात् from his own neck, चन्द्राभम् bright as the moon, वैडूर्यतरलम् set with a lustrous beryl, अस्य his, हारम् necklace, मुच्य having loosed, हनूमतः of Hanuman, कण्ठे upon the neck, बबन्ध च bound it
entries.40.24: उरसि upon his breast, निबद्धेन fastened, तेन by that, महता great, हारेण necklace, कपिः the monkey, चन्द्रेण by the moon, आक्रान्तमस्तकः its summit overtaken, हेमशैलेन्द्रः as the lord of golden mountains, रराज shone
entries.40.25: राघवस्य of Raghava, एतत् this, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, महाबलाः the mighty, ते those, वानराः vanaras, उत्थायोत्थाय rising one after another, शिरसा with their heads, पादौ his feet, प्रणम्य having saluted, निर्जग्मुः went forth
entries.40.26: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सः he, रामेण by Rama, निरन्तरम् closely, उरोगतः held to his breast, धर्मात्मा the righteous, विभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, ते they, सर्वे all, बाष्पविक्लवाः overcome with tears
entries.40.27: ते they, सर्वे च all, बाष्पकलाः their voices choked with weeping, साश्रुनेत्राः their eyes filled with tears, विचेतसः bereft of sense, तदा then, राघवम् Raghava, त्यजन्तः as they parted from, दुःखेन with grief, सम्मूढाः इव as though bewildered
entries.40.28: महात्मना by the great-souled, तेन by that, राघवेण by Raghava, एवम् thus, कृतप्रसादाः shown favour, सर्वे all, देही the embodied soul, देहम् the body, त्यजन् इव as it quits, स्वं स्वम् each his own, गृहम् home, जग्मुः went to
entries.40.29: ततः तु then, ते those, राक्षसऋक्षवानराः rakshasas and bears and vanaras, रघुवंशवर्धनम् increaser of the line of Raghu, रामम् to Rama, प्रणम्य having bowed, वियोगजाश्रुप्रतिपूर्णलोचनाः their eyes brimming with tears born of parting, निवासिनः यथा as those who had dwelt there, प्रतिप्रयाताः तु departed again
entries.41.1: महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, रामः Rama, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् the bears and vanaras and rakshasas, विसृज्य च having dismissed, भ्रातृभिः सहितः together with his brothers, सुखी happy, सुखम् in happiness, प्रमुमोद rejoiced
entries.41.2: अथ then, अपराह्णसमये in the hour of the afternoon, राघवः Raghava, भ्रातृभिः सह along with his brothers, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, प्रभाषिताम् uttered, मधुराम् a sweet, वाणीम् voice, शुश्राव heard
entries.41.3: सौम्य O gentle one, राम O Rama, सौम्येन with a kindly, वदनेन countenance, माम् me, निरीक्षस्व look upon, प्रभो O lord, माम् me, कुबेरभवनात् from the abode of Kubera, प्राप्तम् come, पुष्पकम् as the Pushpaka, विद्धि know
entries.41.4: नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, तव your, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having learnt, भवनं प्रति toward his abode, उपस्थातुम् to present myself, गतः अस्मि I went, सः च and he, माम् to me, प्रत्यभाषत replied
entries.41.5: महात्मना by the great-souled, नरेन्द्रेण lord of men, राघवेण by Raghava, दुर्धर्षम् the unassailable, राक्षसेश्वरम् lord of the rakshasas, रावणम् Ravana, युधि in battle, निहत्य having slain, त्वम् you, निर्जितः have been won
entries.41.6: सगणे with his hosts, सपुत्रे with his sons, सहबान्धवे with his kinsmen, तस्मिन् when that, दुरात्मनि wicked one, रावणे Ravana, हते was slain, मम अपि mine too, परमा was the utmost, प्रीतिः joy
entries.41.7: सौम्य O gentle one, सः that, त्वम् you, परमात्मना by that supreme soul, रामेण by Rama, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, निर्जितः have been won, तम् एव him alone, वह bear, अहम् I, ते to you, आज्ञापयामि so command
entries.41.8: यत् that, त्वम् you, राघवनन्दनम् the delight of the Raghavas, वहेः should bear, एषः this, मे my, परमः highest, कामः हि desire indeed, लोकस्य of the world, संयानम् O conveyance, विगतज्वरः free of care, गच्छस्व go
entries.41.9: सः अहम् so I, महात्मनः of the great-souled, धनदस्य giver of wealth, शासनम् the command, आज्ञाय having received, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, अनुप्राप्तः have come, निर्विशङ्कः without misgiving, माम् me, प्रतीक्ष look for
entries.41.10: धनदाज्ञया by the command of the lord of wealth, सर्वेषाम् of all, सर्वभूतानाम् beings, अदृश्यः unseen, अहम् I, तव your, आज्ञाम् command, परिपालयन् obeying, प्रभावेण by my power, चरामि move about
entries.41.11: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, तदा then, महाबलः the mighty, रामः Rama, पुष्पकेण by the Pushpaka, पुनः again, आगतम् returned, विमानम् the aerial car, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पुष्पकम् to the Pushpaka, उवाच said
entries.41.12: विमानवर O best of aerial cars, पुष्पक O Pushpaka, यदि एवम् if it be so, ते to you, स्वागतम् welcome, अस्तु be, धनेशस्य of the lord of wealth, आनुकूल्यात् through his favour, वृत्तदोषः a fault of conduct, नः to us, न भवेत् shall not arise
entries.41.13: तदा then, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, राघवः Raghava, लाजैश्चैव with parched grain, तथा likewise, पुष्पैः with flowers, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, धूपैश्चैव and with incense, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, पूजयित्वा having worshipped
entries.41.14: गम्यताम् go now, इति thus, उवाच च and said, यदा whenever, स्मरे I call you to mind, त्वम् you, आगच्छ come, सौम्य O gentle one, सिद्धानाम् of the siddhas, गतौ in their course, विषादेन with sorrow, मा योजय do not join them, ते for you, प्रतिघातश्च and hindrance, मा भूत् let there be none, यथेष्टम् at will, दिशः to the quarters, गच्छतः as you go
entries.41.15: रामेण by Rama, एवमस्तु so be it, इति thus, पूजयित्वा having been honoured, विसर्जितम् dismissed, तत् that, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, तदा then, तस्मात् from that place, अभिप्रेताम् the desired, दिशम् quarter, प्रायात् went to
entries.41.16: एवम् thus, सुकृतात्मनि of virtuous nature, तस्मिन् when that, पुष्पके Pushpaka, अन्तर्हिते had vanished, भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, रघुनन्दनम् to the delight of the Raghus, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.41.17: वीर O hero, विविधात्मनि of manifold nature, त्वयि when you, प्रशासति rule, अमानुषाणाम् of superhuman, सत्त्वानाम् beings, व्याहृतानि utterances, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, दृश्यन्ते are witnessed
entries.41.18: राघव O Raghava, सत्वानाम् of creatures, अनामयश्च and free of sickness, अयम् this, साग्रः a full, मासः month, गतः हि has indeed passed, जीर्णानाम् अपि even of the aged, सत्त्वानाम् creatures, मृत्युः death, न आयाति comes not
entries.41.19: राजन् O king, नार्यः the women, अरोगप्रसवाः bear children without sickness, मानवाः हि men indeed, वपुष्मन्तः are of goodly body, पुरवासिनः dwelling in the city, जनस्य of the people, हर्षश्च and the joy, अभ्यधिकः is beyond measure
entries.41.20: पर्जन्यः the rain-god, काले in season, अमृतम् nectar-like, पयः water, पातयन् sending down, वर्षति rains, एते these, वाताश्चापि and the winds too, स्पर्शयुक्ताः pleasant to the touch, सुखाः agreeable, शिवाः benign, प्रवान्ति blow
entries.41.21: राजन् O king, नरेश्वरः a ruler of men, ईदृशः such, अनश्वरः imperishable, राजा king, भवेत् may there be, इति thus, पुरे in the city, पौरजानपदाः तथा both townsfolk and country folk, कथयन्ति say
entries.41.22: भरतेन by Bharata, समीरिताः uttered, एताः these, सुमधुराः most sweet, वाचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, नृपसत्तमः best of kings, रामः Rama, मुदा with joy, युक्तः filled, बभूव became
entries.42.1: ततः then, सः that, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, रामः Rama, हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, विसृज्य having dismissed, तदा then, अशोकवनिकाम् the ashoka grove, प्रविवेश entered
entries.42.2: चन्दनागुरुचूतैश्च with sandal and aloe and mango trees, तुङ्गकालेयकैः अपि and with tunga and kaleyaka trees, देवदारुवनैश्चापि and with groves of deodar, समन्तात् on every side, उपशोभिताम् made beautiful
entries.42.3: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमधूकपनसासनैः with champaka and ashoka and punnaga and madhuka and panasa and asana trees, विधूमज्वलनप्रभैः bright as smokeless flame, पारिजातैश्च and with parijatas, शोभिताम् adorned
entries.42.4: लोध्रनीपार्जुनैः with lodhra and nipa and arjuna, नागैः with naga trees, सप्तपर्णातिमुक्तकैः with saptaparna and atimuktaka, मन्दारकदलीगुल्मलताजालसमावृताम् covered with thickets of mandara and plantain and shrubs and creepers
entries.42.5: प्रियङ्गुभिः with priyangu, कदम्बैश्च and with kadamba, तथा च and likewise, वकुलैः अपि with bakula too, जम्बूभिः with jambu, दाडिमैश्चैव and with pomegranate, कोविदारैश्च and with kovidara, शोभिताम् made lovely
entries.42.6: सर्वदा at all seasons, रम्यैः with lovely, कुसुमैः blossoms, मनोरमैः delightful, फलवद्भिः laden with fruit, दिव्यगन्धरसोपेतैः endowed with heavenly fragrance and savour, तरुणाङ्कुरपल्लवैः with young shoots and sprays
entries.42.7: तथैव likewise, शिल्पिभिः by craftsmen, परिकल्पितैः fashioned, दिव्यैः heavenly, तरुभिः with trees, चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यैः rich in fair sprays and flowers, मत्तभ्रमरसङ्कुलैः thronged with intoxicated bees
entries.42.8: कोकिलैः with cuckoos, भृङ्गराजैश्च and with bhringaraja birds, नानावर्णैः of many hues, पक्षिभिः with birds, चूतवृक्षावतंसकैः with mango trees for its crest, शतशः by the hundred, चित्राम् wondrous, शोभिताम् adorned
entries.42.9: तत्रत्यपादपाः the trees standing there, केचित् some, शातकुम्भनिभाः like wrought gold, केचित् some, अग्निशिखोपमाः like tongues of flame, अन्ये others, नीलाञ्जननिभाः like dark collyrium, भान्ति shone
entries.42.10: सुरभीणि fragrant, पुष्पाणि flowers, विविधानि च and various, माल्यानि garlands, विविधाकाराः of many shapes, दीर्घिकाः lotus-ponds, परमवारिणा with excellent water, पूर्णाः full
entries.42.11: माणिक्यकृतसोपानाः with steps wrought of ruby, स्फाटिकान्तरकुट्टिमाः paved within with crystal, फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवनाः with beds of blown lotuses and lilies, चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः graced with chakravaka birds
entries.42.12: दात्यूहशुकसङ्घुष्टाः loud with gallinules and parrots, हंससारसनादिताः resounding with swans and cranes, पुष्पवद्भिः flowering, तीरजैः growing on the banks, तरुभिश्च and with trees, उपशोभिताः made beautiful
entries.42.13: विविधाकारैः of various forms, प्राकारैः with enclosing walls, शिलातलैश्च and with slabs of stone, शोभिताः adorned, तत्रैव च and in that very place, वनोद्देशे in a tract of the wood, वैडूर्यमणिसन्निभैः like beryl gems
entries.42.14: शाद्वलैः with lawns of grass, परमोपेताम् richly furnished, पुष्पितद्रुमकाननाम् its woods of trees in blossom, तत्र there, सङ्घर्षजातानाम् grown close together, पुष्पशालिनाम् rich in bloom, वृक्षाणाम् of the trees
entries.42.15: प्रस्तराः the rock-slabs, पुष्पशबलाः dappled with flowers, नभः the sky, तारागणैः इव as with hosts of stars, इन्द्रस्य of Indra, नन्दनम् हि यथा as the Nandana grove, ब्राह्मम् of Brahma, चैत्ररथम् यथा as the Chaitraratha
entries.42.16: रामस्य of Rama, काननम् the grove, सन्निवेशनम् his retreat, तथाभूतम् हि was even such, बह्वासनगृहोपेताम् furnished with many seats and bowers, लतागृहसमावृताम् set about with houses of creepers
entries.42.17: रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, स्फीताम् luxuriant, अशोकवनिकाम् the ashoka grove, प्रविश्य having entered, शुभाकारे of fair form, पुष्पप्रकरभूषिते strewn with heaps of flowers, आसने upon a seat
entries.42.18: कुशास्तरणसंस्तीर्णे spread with a covering of kusha grass, रामः Rama, सन्निषसाद ह sat down, सीताम् Sita, हस्तेन by the hand, आदाय having taken, शुचि pure, मधुमैरेयकम् honey-wine
entries.42.19: काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, पुरन्दरः Purandara, शचीम् इव as he does Shachi, पाययामास gave her to drink, समृष्टानि well dressed, मांसानि च and meats, विविधानि various, फलानि च and fruits
entries.42.20: किङ्कराः the attendants, रामस्य of Rama, अभ्यवहारार्थम् for his repast, तूर्णम् swiftly, आहरन् brought, नृत्यगीतविशारदाः skilled in dance and song, राजानम् before the king, उपानृत्यन् च and danced
entries.42.21: बालाः young, रूपवत्यश्च and beautiful, पानवशानुगाः yielding to wine, स्त्रियः women, मनोभिरामाः ravishing the mind, ताः those, रामाः lovely ones, रामः Rama, रमयताम् among those who give delight, वरः the best
entries.42.22: नृत्यगीतविशारदाः skilled in dance and song, काकुत्स्थम् before Kakutstha, उपानृत्यन्त danced, मनोभिरामाः ravishing the mind, ताः those, रामाः lovely ones, रामः Rama, रमयताम् among those who give delight, वरः the best
entries.42.23: धर्मात्मा the righteous one, नित्यम् ever, परमभूषितः richly adorned, रमयामास gave them delight, सः he, तया that, सीतया सार्धम् together with Sita, आसीनः seated, विरराज ह shone
entries.42.24: अरुन्धत्या with Arundhati, सह आसीनः seated, वसिष्ठः इव like Vasishtha, तेजसा in splendour, एवम् thus, रामः Rama, मुदा with joy, युक्तः filled, सुरसुतोपमाम् like a daughter of the gods, सीताम् Sita
entries.42.25: वैदेहीम् the princess of Videha, अहन्यहनि day after day, देववत् like a god, रमयामास delighted, तथा so, चिरम् for long, विहरतोः as they disported themselves, तयोः of those two, सीताराघवयोः Sita and Raghava
entries.42.26: शुभः the auspicious, सदा ever, भोगदः bestowing enjoyment, शैशिरः of the cold season, कालः time, अत्यक्रामत् passed away, विविधान् various, भोगान् enjoyments, प्राप्तयोः of the two who had attained, शिशिरागमः the coming of the cold season, अतीतः went by
entries.42.27: धर्मवित् knower of dharma, पूर्वाह्णे in the forenoon, धर्मेण according to dharma, धर्मकार्याणि the rites of duty, कृत्वा having performed, शेषम् for the remaining, दिवसभागार्धम् half portion of the day, अन्तःपुरगतः gone to the inner apartments, अभवत् he was
entries.42.28: सीता अपि Sita too, पौर्वाह्णिकानि belonging to the forenoon, देवकार्याणि वै the rites of the gods, कृत्वा having performed, सर्वासाम् of all, श्वश्रूणाम् her mothers-in-law, अविशेषतः without distinction, पूजाम् the honouring, अकरोत् performed
entries.42.29: ततः then, विचित्राभरणाम्बरा in wondrous ornaments and garments, त्रिविष्टपे in heaven, उपविष्टम् seated, सहस्राक्षम् the thousand-eyed one, शची यथा as Shachi does, रामम् to Rama, अभ्यगच्छत् came
entries.42.30: राघवः Raghava, तु then, कल्याणेन with auspiciousness, समन्विताम् endowed, पत्नीम् his wife, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अतुलम् unmatched, प्रहर्षम् delight, लेभे obtained, साधु साधु इति च and well and well, अब्रवीत् said
entries.42.31: वरारोहाम् of fair form, सुरसुतोपमाम् like a daughter of the gods, सीताम् to Sita, अब्रवीच्च and he said, वैदेहि O princess of Videha, त्वयि in you, मे my, अपत्यलाभः the gain of offspring, समुपस्थितः is at hand
entries.42.32: वरारोहे O fair one, किम् what, इच्छसि do you wish, तव your, कामः desire, किम् what, क्रियताम् shall be done, वैदेही the princess of Videha, स्मितम् a smile, कृत्वा तु having made, अथ then, रामम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.42.33: राघव O Raghava, गङ्गातीरोपविष्टानाम् seated on the bank of the Ganga, उग्रतेजसाम् of fierce splendour, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, पुण्यानि the holy, तपोवनानि penance-groves, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I desire
entries.42.34: देव O lord, फलमूलाशिनाम् who live on fruit and root, पादमूलेषु at their feet, वर्तितुम् to abide, एषः this, मे my, परमः highest, कामः desire, यत् that, मूलफलभोजिनाम् of those who eat root and fruit
entries.42.35: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, एकरात्रम् अपि even for a single night, तपोवने in the penance-grove, निवसेयम् may I dwell, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of untiring deeds, रामेण by Rama, तथा इति so be it, प्रतिज्ञातं च and it was promised, वैदेहि O princess of Videha, विस्रब्धा at ease, भव be, श्वः tomorrow, असंशयम् without doubt, गमिष्यसि you shall go
entries.42.36: एवम् thus, मैथिलीम् to Maithili, जनकात्मजाम् the daughter of Janaka, उक्त्वा तु having spoken, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, रामः Rama, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends, मध्यकक्षान्तरम् into the middle court, निर्जगाम came forth
entries.43.1: तत्र there, उपविष्टम् seated, राजानम् the king, विचक्षणाः skilled men, बहुरूपाणाम् of many kinds, कथानाम् of tales, हास्यकाराः makers of mirth, समन्ततः on every side, उपासन्ते attended
entries.43.2: विजयः Vijaya, मधुमत्तश्च and Madhumatta, काश्यपः Kashyapa, मङ्गलः Mangala, कुटः Kuta, सुराजः Suraja, कालियः Kaliya, भद्रः Bhadra, दन्तवक्रः Dantavakra, सुमागधः Sumagadha
entries.43.3: एते these, संहृष्टाः delighted, महात्मनः of the great-souled, राघवस्य of Raghava, परिहाससमन्विताः full of jest, बहुविधाः of many sorts, कथाः tales, कथयन्ति स्म used to tell
entries.43.4: ततः then, कस्याञ्चित् in the course of a certain, कथायाम् tale, राघवः Raghava, समभाषत spoke, भद्र O Bhadra, नगरे in the city, विषयेषु च and in the provinces, काः what, कथाः tales, वर्तन्ते are current
entries.43.5: पौरजानपदाः the townsfolk and country folk, जनाः people, माम् me, आश्रितानि concerning, कानि what, आहुः do they say, सीताम् Sita, समाश्रित्य concerning, किं च and what, भरतम् Bharata, किं च and what, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana
entries.43.6: शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, उद्दिश्य with regard to, किं नु what indeed, मातरम् my mother, कैकयीम् Kaikeyi, किं नु what indeed, राजानः kings, वरे in the matter of a boon, राज्ये in a kingdom, वक्तव्यताम् to being talked of, व्रजन्ति च and come
entries.43.7: रामेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्ते तु when it was said, भद्रः Bhadra, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, अब्रवीत् said, राजन् O king, पुरवासिनाम् among the dwellers of the city, शुभाः auspicious, कथाः tales, स्थिताः are current, वर्तन्ते do prevail
entries.43.8: सौम्य O gentle one, पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, दशग्रीववधार्जितम् won by the slaying of the ten-necked one, अमुं तु that very, विजयम् victory, स्वपुरे in your own city, पौरैः by the citizens, भूयिष्ठम् most of all, कथ्यन्ते is told
entries.43.9: भद्रेण by Bhadra, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, राघवः Raghava, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, यथातत्त्वम् just as it truly is, सर्वम् all, निरवशेषतः without omission, कथयस्व relate
entries.43.10: पुरवासिनः the dwellers of the city, यानि which, शुभाशुभानि good and evil, वाक्यानि words, आहुः utter, इदानीम् now, श्रुत्वा having heard them, शुभम् what is good, कुर्याम् I may do, अशुभानि च and what is evil, न कुर्याम् I may leave undone
entries.43.11: विस्रब्धः with confidence, निर्भयम् fearlessly, विगतज्वरः free of anxiety, कथयस्व च and relate, यथा how, पौराः the citizens, जनपदेषु च and in the country parts, पापाः the ill-disposed, कथयन्ति speak
entries.43.12: राघवेण by Raghava, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, भद्रः Bhadra, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, सुसमाहितः fully composed, महाबाहुम् to the mighty-armed one, सुरुचिरम् most pleasing, वचः speech, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.43.13: राजन् O king, पौराः the citizens, चत्वरापणरथ्यासु in squares and markets and streets, वनेषु in the woods, उपवनेषु च and in the groves, यथा how, शुभाशुभम् good and evil, कथयन्ति speak, शृणु hear
entries.43.14: रामः Rama, समुद्रे upon the ocean, दुष्करम् a hard thing, सेतुबन्धनम् the binding of a bridge, कृतवान् has done, पूर्वकैः by men of old, कैश्चित् by any, सदानवैः with the danavas, देवैः अपि even by the gods, अश्रुतम् unheard of
entries.43.15: दुराधर्षः the unassailable, रावणश्च and Ravana, सबलवाहनः with his troops and mounts, हतः was slain, वानराश्च and the vanaras, ऋक्षाश्च and the bears, राक्षसैः सह along with the rakshasas, वशम् under his sway, नीताः were brought
entries.43.16: राघवः Raghava, सङ्ख्ये in battle, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा च having slain, सीताम् Sita, आहृत्य having recovered, अमर्षम् his indignation, पृष्ठतः behind him, कृत्वा having put, स्ववेश्म to his own house, पुनः again, आनयत् brought her
entries.43.17: पुरा formerly, रावणेन by Ravana, बलात् by force, हृताम् carried off, अङ्कम् upon his lap, आरोप्य तु having been set, तस्य his, हृदये in the heart, सीतासम्भोगजम् born of union with Sita, सुखम् the pleasure, कीदृशम् of what sort is it
entries.43.18: पुरा formerly, लङ्काम् अपि to Lanka too, नीताम् carried, अशोकवनिकाम् the ashoka grove, गताम् taken to, रक्षसाम् of the rakshasas, वशम् into the power, आपन्नाम् fallen, कथम् how, रामः Rama, न कुत्सते holds her not in reproach
entries.43.19: अस्माकम् अपि ours too, दारेषु in the case of wives, सहनीयम् must be borne with, भविष्यति it will be, यथा हि for as, राजा the king, कुरुते does, प्रजा the people, तम् him, अनुवर्तते follow
entries.43.20: राजन् O king, एवम् thus, बहुविधाः of many kinds, वाचः words, पुरवासिनः the city dwellers, वदन्ति speak, सर्वेषु in all, नगरेषु च the towns, जनपदेषु च and in the country parts
entries.43.21: तस्य his, एवम् thus, भाषितम् spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Raghava, परमार्तवत् as one utterly stricken, सर्वान् all, सुहृदः his friends, उवाच asked, एतत् this, माम् to me, कथम् how, ब्रवीथ do you say
entries.43.22: सर्वे तु all of them, शिरसा with their heads, भूमौ upon the ground, अभिवाद्य having saluted, प्रणम्य च and having bowed, दीनम् sorrowful, राघवम् to Raghava, प्रत्यूचुः replied, एतत् this, एवम् is so, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.43.23: काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, शत्रुसूदनः destroyer of foes, सर्वेषाम् by all, समुदीरितम् uttered, वाक्यम् the speech, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, तदा then, वयस्यान् his companions, विसर्जयामास dismissed
